name: publish_sentence_note
description: Keep your explanation of a dialog sentence's grammar (a chat with data.about_sentence), so the app shows it the next time Jan long-presses that sentence. The sentence exactly as data.about_sentence.sentence has it (case and punctuation don't matter), the explanation (Markdown, phone-sized), the language it is in (gloss_lang, default Jan's base) and the sentence's (language, default the village's; on a visit, data.about_sentence.language). Replaces your earlier note of the same sentence in the same languages.

sentence.description: The sentence as data.about_sentence.sentence has it, e.g. "Dvanajst krav se pase."

text.description: The explanation, Markdown, at most 4000 characters

gloss_lang.description: The language the explanation is in: "en", "sl", "de", "it" …; default Jan's base

language.description: The sentence's language, e.g. "it" on a visit to an Italian town; default the village's
